And the words मध्ये 'in the middle', पदे 'in the foot' and निवचने 'speechless' are optionally called गति , when कृ follows, the sense not being of placing.

Terms: गति-उर्सि-मनसि

The affix यञ् comes, in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. मधु and 2. बभ्रु when the words so formed mean ब्राह्मण and कौशिक respectively.

Terms: यञ्

The affix मतुप्‌ is added to the words मधु etc. in the four senses given above.

Terms: मतुप्‌

After the word मध्य there is the affix म in the remaining senses.

Terms: म

The affixes यत् and ष come with the force of मतुप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the word मधु।

Terms: यत् and ष

The affix यत् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the word मधु with the force of मतुप्।

Terms: यत्

The Locative -7th case-affix is not elided after मध्य when गुरु follows.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision
